positive.description: P1 — Create a private Mac mini draft; only confirm and activate after separate user approval. Use a fresh dedicated reviewer account and a unique REVIEW run label. After reviewing the actual draft, send this separate follow-up: I have reviewed this draft and the separate synthetic contact details. They are correct. Confirm and activate this intent for matching, while keeping it off the public feed.
positive.prompt: Please use English throughout, including all saved titles, descriptions, categories and summaries. Use Matchall to create a draft for this fictional review demo, labeled REVIEW-20261016-SG-MINI-01, titled "REVIEW SG MINI 01 — Wanted: M2 Mac mini". I am looking for one used M2 Mac mini with 16 GB RAM and 512 GB SSD, in working condition with proof of purchase. My budget is up to SGD 600, and I can collect it in Singapore. There is no rush. Keep the listing private, off the public feed. Store review-buyer@example.com separately as my synthetic private contact, never in business fields. Preserve the English wording and Singapore location in the saved fields. Show me the actual saved draft and wait for my approval before activating it.
positive.tools_triggered: ingest_intent, get_intent, confirm_intent, activate_intent; set_intent_contact if necessary
positive.expected_behavior: Keep contact data separate. Show actual draft and unknown fields. Wait for follow-up approval. Activate the same ID, keep visibility private, use idempotent writes and bounded retries without duplicates.

positive.description: P2 — Read actual matches for the active demo buyer intention. Setup: a separate demo seller has a private active M2 Mac mini offer with 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD, proof of purchase, normal wear, price SGD 550 and Singapore collection. Confirm the actual pair before subsequent exchange tests.
positive.prompt: Show the latest matches for my REVIEW-20261016-SG-MINI-01 Mac mini intent. Compare the model, memory, storage, price and location. Use only actual returned results and explain any unknown or unverified information. Do not contact anyone.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned IDs and business summaries. Distinguish unknown/unverified fields and empty results. Do not reveal counterpart contacts or invoke write/exchange tools.

positive.description: P3 — Buyer requests mutual contact exchange for the specific demo seller match.
positive.prompt: For the REVIEW-20261016-SG-MINI-01-SELLER demo match we just reviewed, I agree to share my reviewed synthetic contact, review-buyer@example.com, only if that demo account also agrees. Request a contact exchange. Do not contact any other match.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual match ID and reviewed current contact version. With no reverse consent, report pending and withhold seller contact. Do not mark either intent fulfilled.

positive.description: P4 — Read mutually authorized contacts in ChatGPT. Setup: after P3, the separate demo seller reviews this exact incoming request and its current synthetic contact in the Matchall website, then explicitly accepts it. This case tests buyer-side authorized retrieval, not seller-side respond_contact_exchange in ChatGPT.
positive.prompt: The other demo account has reviewed and accepted the request in Matchall. Check the existing contact exchange for my REVIEW-20261016-SG-MINI-01 intent. Show the contact details only if Matchall confirms mutual approval and current access. Do not create another request or mark either listing completed.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the existing actual exchange. Show contacts only when status is approved and current access is authorized. Otherwise state pending, revoked, expired or unavailable accurately and withhold contacts. Do not create a second exchange, accept on behalf of the seller, or fulfill either listing.

positive.description: P5 — Pause buyer matching while preserving the saved intention.
positive.prompt: Pause matching for my REVIEW-20261016-SG-MINI-01 Mac mini intent. Keep the record for later. Do not close it, mark it completed, or claim that its data has been deleted.
positive.expected_behavior: Use pause, not close or fulfill. Confirm returned paused lifecycle. Do not claim deletion or revocation of previously viewed information.
